brief:
Israel has killed Khaled Abu Nada, undersecretary of the Palestinian Ministry of Education, along with his wife in west Deir el-Balah, central Gaza, according to Middle East Eye. The strike occurred in the densely populated area of central Gaza amid ongoing military operations.

No further details were immediately available regarding the circumstances of the reported strike or the broader context of the operation.
dek: Israel reportedly kills Education Ministry official in central Gaza Israel has killed the undersecretary of the Ministry of Education, Khaled Abu Nada, alongside his wife in west Deir el-Balah, central Gaza, according to Al Jazeera.
title: Israel kills Palestinian Education Ministry undersecretary in Gaza
